figure_1.Img_description: Three panels report registered B/F/S operational success counts, all per-block S-F score differences, and the frozen finite-schedule SLA fields for V4 plus the separately registered V5 candidate.
figure_1.Img_review: The figure encodes only accepted V4/V5 values, labels exact counts, marks the 16/18 threshold, and distinguishes the later V5 schedule. It does not display population confidence intervals or invented observations.
figure_1.Caption_review: The caption matches all three panels, states that V5 is separate and later, labels score differences as descriptive rather than population estimates, and discloses that the F-S field is logically redundant.
figure_1.Figrefs_review: Figure 1 is introduced at the start of the results section and each panel is interpreted in the adjacent results and control discussion.
